user_signal.goal_or_constraint: Universal Continuity must apply its own challenge-distill-learn-evolve maintenance method to itself, close executable proof gaps rather than only restating policy, and avoid forcing artificial changes when a complete audit legitimately finds no repair is needed.
user_signal.counterexample: SYSTEM_MAINTENANCE_POLICY 1.6 already required meta-governance alignment, systemic learning, falsification and second-order review, but runtime/system_audit.py had not yet selected all of those policy triggers/faults and runtime/meta_maintenance.py could accept label-only second-order review while forcing nonempty changed_paths even for a valid no-change conclusion.

failure_classes: policy-to-auditor drift: maintenance policy 1.6 added meta-governance and new failure scenarios but system_audit executable coverage lagged the normative surface
mutation theater pressure: meta-maintenance required nonempty changed_paths, so a correct no-change audit could not close without inventing a mutation

falsification-as-label: a systemic run could satisfy second-order review with a PASS string without recording the actual second-order findings, and explicit failure/counterexample evidence was not mechanically required by the current schema
topology-bound proof ambiguity: propagation evidence from a historical meta run must not be silently reused as proof for a later BUSINESS-owner topology
system_impact_map: Universal maintenance audit planning and trigger escalation
Synthetic fault inventory and regression coverage
All current BUSINESS owners only as remote metadata/conformance scope; no business task state or lease mutation
falsification_checks: Pass the canonical uppercase USER_CHALLENGES_MAINTENANCE_METHOD_OR_GLOBAL_COMPLETENESS trigger and require FULL_CONTROL_PLANE plus SYNTHETIC_FAULT_INJECTION instead of a routine audit.
Remove counterexample, falsification_checks or second_order_findings from a schema-1.1 systemic run and require fail-closed behavior.
Submit a complete schema-1.1 NO_CHANGE_REQUIRED run with inspected paths and no changed paths and require PASS, proving the harness does not reward needless mutation.
Simulate a methodology receipt-contract version change while ENTRYPOINT keeps old wording and require system audit to flag stale semantics.
Add a synthetic BUSINESS owner and require not only adaptation/execution cache convergence but current meta propagation evidence to cover the new topology before local control-plane audit can PASS.

Challenge the initial diagnosis that central Financial/A-share owner validation caches were stale by comparing commits; reject that diagnosis if the central heads are descendants of the adapter-embedded regression baselines.

sources.observation: Current OpenAI agent evaluation guidance uses datasets, graders and trace-level evidence to evaluate workflow behavior rather than relying on an agent's self-description of what occurred.
sources.rationale: Supports keeping the deterministic meta-maintenance record separate from independent semantic evaluation and strengthens the rule that structured process conformance is not execution/outcome proof.

sources.observation: Tracing exposes session, turn and step-level execution structure, including tool and workflow activity, so evaluation can bind claims to an observed trajectory.
sources.rationale: Supports exact-action evidence binding and the open gate for a distinct held-out/live trajectory grader.

sources.observation: Evaluation should include production-relevant variation and edge cases instead of relying on a single happy-path example.
sources.rationale: Supports expanding the synthetic fault set around meta-governance omission, stale receipt semantics and topology changes.

sources.observation: OpenAI's current product guidance is moving new evaluation work toward datasets/graders rather than treating a specific legacy eval API as a permanent architecture dependency.
sources.rationale: Adopt the general dataset/grader/trace discipline but do not hard-wire Universal Continuity to one product-specific evaluation API or create a new dependency solely for this repair.

alternatives.rationale: The policy already contained the stronger obligations; leaving executable audit/harness coverage behind would preserve the exact policy-to-operation gap found by this self-audit.

A new role or registry would add authority/coupling without solving self-attestation. The existing policy, meta harness and system audit already have unique ownership and can express the missing controls.

Smallest reversible repair: extend the existing meta schema/validator, align system-audit trigger/fault coverage with policy 1.6, add regressions, preserve historical schema 1.0 evidence, and keep independent semantic assurance explicitly open.

instruction_surface.reason: ENTRYPOINT already routes explicit maintenance/global audit signals to the current maintenance and evolution authorities. The defect was executable verifier drift, not missing account/startup routing. Expanding ChatGPT account instructions would duplicate repository authority and add prompt cost without evidence of a routing failure.

propagation.mechanism: The repair remains centralized in Universal Continuity's maintenance verifier/audit runtime. Current owner adapters were re-read to verify their shared operational_hygiene/evolution bindings and assurance boundaries; no owner-local business rule, task checkpoint, lease or business output is rewritten.
override_scan_evidence: All four current BUSINESS owners remain bound to artifact_io@1.0 + operational_hygiene@1.0 + evolution@1.0.

Financial and A-share central validation receipts were initially suspected stale, but commit comparison falsified that diagnosis: the central Financial head is 25 commits ahead of its adapter-embedded baseline and the central A-share head is 4 commits ahead.
Novel and Video adapters preserve explicit self-attestation/isolation boundaries and no owner adapter attempts to override Universal maintenance authority.

complexity_efficiency.tool_or_remote_read_delta: FULL_CONTROL_PLANE maintenance only: current owner adapter metadata is re-read when propagation proof is required; ordinary business turns are unchanged.
complexity_efficiency.duplicate_rule_effect: CONSOLIDATE_IN_EXISTING_RUNTIME: SYSTEM_MAINTENANCE_POLICY remains normative; runtime/meta_maintenance.py and runtime/system_audit.py remain its existing executable verifiers.
complexity_efficiency.migration_compatibility_effect: NO_CONTINUITY_PROTOCOL_BUMP_AND_NO_METHODOLOGY_PROFILE_BUMP; meta run schema 1.1 keeps schema 1.0 readable as historical evidence.
complexity_efficiency.test_observability_effect: Adds deterministic negative tests for canonical maintenance trigger escalation, explicit falsification/second-order evidence, no-change closure and stale receipt semantics.

superseded_or_demoted_surfaces: Schema 1.0 meta-maintenance remains readable as historical evidence but is no longer the current run contract for new systemic maintenance closures.
The implicit assumption that every maintenance run must mutate a file is superseded by an explicit NO_CHANGE_REQUIRED path with inspected-path and reason evidence.
The assumption that a second_order_challenge=PASS label is sufficient for a new systemic run is superseded by explicit second_order_findings under schema 1.1.

regression_or_eval_refs: GitHub Actions run 38083693672: expected fail on intentionally stale maintenance cache before cache sync
GitHub Actions run 38083708497: local control-plane audit PASS after cache sync; pytest exposed current-run schema/topology-convergence gaps that this closure addresses
second_order_findings: Requiring more fields can create bureaucratic form-filling without semantic lift; therefore assurance remains STRUCTURED_PROCESS_CONFORMANCE_ONLY and independent semantic review stays open.
A no-change path can be abused to avoid necessary repair; it is allowed only with inspected_paths, explicit no_change_reason and the same validation/closure obligations as a changed run.
Historical meta runs must remain historical evidence rather than being silently reinterpreted under a later owner topology; current global closure needs a current topology-bound run.
The initial suspicion of stale Financial/A-share central owner caches was falsified by commit ancestry, demonstrating that the maintenance loop must challenge its own diagnoses before mutation.
Adding the canonical user-challenge trigger to audit planning increases work only on explicit/systemic maintenance paths and does not alter ordinary business hot-path loading.

open_gates: Universal operator-dependence heldout/live trajectory still requires a distinct grader and independent evidence verifier.
A truly fresh product chat with a newly admitted real BUSINESS owner remains unproven.
Future real owner actions still require methodology receipt 1.3 exact-action independent evidence and semantic verification where applicable.
Financial live prose-quality promotion and Personalized Writing DNA outcome evidence remain open.
Video strict isolated review/generation gateway remains open.
Arbitrary ChatGPT GitHub mutation still lacks universal pre-write WRITE_PATH_ENFORCED semantics.
Remote owner sweep evidence is gathered by the maintenance runner and is not yet a first-class universal remote-observation receipt with automatic freshness comparison.
closure.unknown_or_open_world_boundary: This self-audit cannot prove that every future model, tool, product, owner-topology or architecture failure class is already anticipated. It proves the covered policy-to-verifier alignment and regressions only; new failures must re-enter the same evidence, falsification and eval loop.
